name: Apostle Aurora
source:
Aurora is the clumsy but loyal Apostle of Dark Lord [url=/c98933]Sieg[/url]. Prior to her transformation she was a Lycanthrope, a type of Gal Monster noted for the ability to virtually instantly change their outfits and cosmetic appearance, though their basic physionomy does not change.

With this power and her human appearance, Aurora has become a specialist of espionage and infiltration of the human countries of The Continent on behalf of her master. As the Monster Realm was preparing an invasion of Zeth, she was assigned to infiltrate the country and use her abilities to investigate its structure, disable the Maginot Line and bring as much chaos and destruction to facilitate the invasion. 

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Aurora]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
